notes: of small power: the of is read as the supplied predicative marker with the adjective rather than as the construct relation; the alternative is named in that unit's note. The ASV's of stands before the construct's own word rather than between the two words of the chain, which is what rule 19's of + noun requires, so the accepted reading holds.
קָמָה is a noun recast as a clause, headed on the English verb carrying its lexeme (rule 46).
